buriedGems: Verification as a first-class loop stage (G-049): the corpus buries human verification workflows, verification authority and unsupported-claim detection inside the Block 06 knowledge fabric; the completeness loop cannot close Evidence->Verification without it being a named subsystem.

Mission/objective representation (G-092): 'Mission' and 'Delegation' stages of the completeness loop are never specified as first-class objects; they exist only as agent 'objectives' and Block 5 'goal representation exists' definition-of-done bullets, plus delegation objects in the identity fabric.

Delegation objects with non-escalation (G-032): bounded, revocable, time-limited, non-escalating delegation including acting-on-behalf-of is buried as Block 02 subsections 25-27 yet is exactly what Mission->Delegation->Worker Execution requires.

Outcome measurement without truth rewriting (G-093): 'outcome measurement exists' and 'no silent production mutation' are single lines in the Block 5 definition of done; they are the Outcome->Memory loop tail.

State reconciliation from conflicting evidence (G-094): a reality reconciliation engine is mentioned in one subsection of the autonomous-ops block; canonical truth cannot survive duplicate events and human corrections without it.

'RLS must not be the only defense' (G-030): defense-in-depth isolation across cache/queue/storage/search/graph/memory/event surfaces is stated as a single line in the identity block and again in event security; it is the constitution's database-security law.
No universal master credential + agent credential broker (G-033): buried in agent fabric sections 84-85; blast-radius containment for any V1 worker.
The agent must not become the owner of the memory system (G-061): a one-line section title in Block 09 with constitutional weight (self-improvement law boundary for memory).

Memory retrieval must never be vector-only (G-015): 'memory should not be vector-only retrieval' plus 'vector embeddings are not truth' guard against authorization bypass through semantic search — critical once pgvector-style indexes exist.

Temporal succession is never silently promoted to causal assertion (G-040): buried as Block 04 section 57; the epistemic discipline separating observed sequence from claimed causation protects canonical truth from AI inference.

Simulation results can never become observed reality (G-041): the isolation invariant is an acceptance-gate line item; V1 needs it the moment any preview/dry-run exists, independent of the deferred simulation universe.
Unknown object types must not silently enter the canonical object store (G-002): one line in the completion package; type-safety of canonical truth.
Three never-conflated version dimensions (G-024): object/schema/policy version separation is a short block-01 section that makes authorization decisions reproducible for audit.

The no-illicit-observation rule of the ambient intelligence bridge (G-088): 'CoreGrid cannot legitimately see private state of a system exposing no permitted observation channel' is the legal/ethical boundary for all ingest — easy to miss inside a strategy block.

Payments and communications as platform rails (G-095, G-096): the corpus never specs them as kernel blocks; they appear only in package lists (block 28), implementation order items (23/24 of block 39) and agent communication-authority sections — yet loop closure (Action reaching reality, notifications) structurally requires them.
Bi-temporal discipline (valid time vs record time) (G-039): buried in reality-graph sections; audit-grade verification in V1 requires distinguishing when something was true from when it was recorded.
Idempotency keys on consequential commands (G-063): a single paragraph in the Block 01 failure model; the difference between a demo and a production platform.

Acceptance-gate test scenario as a harness pattern (G-097): the teacher/attendance worked scenario is a reusable V1 verification-harness template mapping directly onto the constitution's mandatory security tests.
contradictions: Dual block-numbering families: 'BLOCK 02' means identity/authority fabric in the 18-block engineering family but physical device intelligence in the reality-fabric family; 'BLOCK 03' means ontology in one family and reality agents in another. The prior classification mixed families when mapping block numbers to phases; requirement sources in this artifact cite families explicitly.

This artifact buckets the capability V1 (G-068, structurally necessary) while the ownership blocker remains unresolved.

GAP-017/018 (SDK economy / App Store): ledger status MAPPED_TO_MOTHER (ECOSYSTEM.md) coexists with the prior classification treating them as outside-V1; this artifact resolves them to V2 Frozen Expansion Surface (G-080) — a bucket assignment, not an override of the ledger's documentation mapping.

Phase 27/33 registry status conflicts (IMPLEMENTED vs SDK-economy-future; live-verified kernel substrate vs ARCHITECTURE_DEFINED registry status) are preserved unchanged per ledger rules; they affect ownership claims, not the V1/V2 bucket derivation.

Sequencing tension: product-strategy Block 30 ('do not build the engines first', engines arrive at Stage 5) versus the engineering family's fixed order (Blocks 01-18 substrate before phases) versus Block 39's 40-step order (foundation -> experience -> public/customer -> intelligence). Three orderings coexist; all agree main-application-first and domain-runtimes-last, which is what V1 adopts (G-091).
